name: Monzaemon
main_effect:
[On Play] By placing 1 Digimon card with [Numemon] in its name from your trash as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, gain 2 memory.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP and ＜Security A. -1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.) until the end of their turn.
source_effect: [Your Turn] While this Digimon has [Monzaemon] or [Numemon] in its name, it gains ＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
